standard.title: Create texts for specific purposes with appropriate vocabulary and conventions
standard.description: create and present spoken, written and multimodal, informative and imaginative texts for specific purposes, selecting vocabulary, expressions, grammatical structures, features and conventions appropriate to text type and context
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can create texts using varied structures and text-type conventions (AC9LS6C05). They create for familiar formats and purposes. They have not yet selected vocabulary and structures deliberately for a specific purpose or created biographical and narrative texts integrating multiple text features.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students create and present informative and imaginative texts for specific purposes — selecting vocabulary, grammatical structures and conventions appropriate to text type, purpose and context.

nodes.label: Selecting vocabulary and structures for purpose
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can select vocabulary, expressions and grammatical structures deliberately to suit the purpose of a text — moving beyond default or most familiar choices.
nodes.minimum_width: Create a text and identify at least three vocabulary or structural choices made because of the text's specific purpose — explaining the reason for each.
nodes.typical_width: Create texts with deliberate vocabulary and structure selection across varied formats — event materials, travel texts, biographical accounts, social media content; use contemporary and emerging vocabulary appropriate to context; select tense and register for purpose; apply text-type conventions consistently.
wider: Create two versions of the same content for different purposes — explicitly contrast the vocabulary, structure and register choices made for each
Annotate a produced text — marking every deliberate vocabulary or structural choice and explaining the purpose reason for each
nodes.hinge_reason: Deliberate vocabulary and structure selection for purpose is the move from producing any text to producing the right text for a given context. Students who produce default texts regardless of purpose cannot meet the audience diversity demands of subsequent bands.

response_modes.reason: Selection awareness requires metacognitive attention to language choices. Annotation tasks and contrastive production scaffold the metalinguistic awareness needed for deliberate selection.

success_criteria: Creates a text with at least three deliberate vocabulary or structural choices explained in terms of purpose
The text is consistently appropriate in register and vocabulary for its specific purpose

nodes.label: Creating and presenting across formats and audiences
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can create and present texts across a range of informative and imaginative formats — using conventions appropriate to each and presenting for real audiences.
nodes.minimum_width: Create and present texts in at least two different formats using appropriate conventions for each.
nodes.typical_width: Create digital slideshows, event materials, travel texts, biographical profiles, cartoons, short stories, role-plays, subtitled content, bilingual menus and recipes, First Nations Country/Place travel materials; use voice recording and digital tools for performance and publication.
wider: Create an original short recording or performance in the target language — demonstrating command of spoken language, visual design and presentation conventions simultaneously
Create a biographical account for a specific audience and purpose — annotating every deliberate vocabulary or structural choice

response_modes.reason: Text creation competence across formats develops through working with varied text types and purposes. The range in the descriptor — digital, biographical, narrative, performative — is the intended development condition.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Creating original recordings, performances and biographical accounts for real audiences produces genuinely purposeful language investment. Digital production makes authentic publishing possible at this level.
success_criteria: Creates texts in at least two different formats with conventions appropriate to each
Presents at least one text to an audience using appropriate delivery for the purpose
